exact_statement: For every finite uniform Boolean output F and every coordinate block Z, with alpha=P_spectral(S_Z nonempty), h2(alpha)<=2I(F). The coefficient two is asymptotically sharp for the full-block spectral flag on Boolean point signs. For two arbitrary fixed subcube indicators p(Z),q(Z) and four arbitrary Boolean cores h_ab(X) on a disjoint block, F(X,Z)=h_(p(Z),q(Z))(X) has no edit-fiber cap or source-independence requirement within this controller algebra. A single complete final joint reference, with at most five flat nonempty control cells and the actual final core marginal, has cost at most E_Z H(F_Z)+K I_Z(F)+2I_X(F), K=4+log2(5)+2/ln2<19/2. Compatible assignments permit K=6+2/ln2<9. Thus Q_access=H(F)-E_Z H(F_Z)<=K I_Z+2I_X. All actual terminals and their physical probabilities are retained; if each accessible core has H<=C I, H(F)<=K I_Z+(C+2)I_X<=max(K,C+2)I(F). Under U<=bI on actual cores use C=2+2b; degree-two actual cores give H<=KI. This covers source-dependent cancellation when source and multiplier are functions of the same two controller states and X, provided the resulting actual core branches are certified. It neither bounds ancestral source-plus-mask influence bills by final influence nor pays arbitrary control-dependent sources or a same-C universal induction. A normalized rational real degree-one output explicitly violates the flag and no-cap access extensions.
